blocks.empathy.heading: Reaching out is the hardest part. We'll make the rest easier.
blocks.empathy.body:
Maybe you've been pushing through for a while, telling yourself it will get better on its own. Maybe someone you love is struggling, and you're not sure how to help. However you got here, it took courage to start looking.

Freedom has been helping people in Louisville for more than 20 years. Our counselors work with individuals, couples, families, and kids as young as 8, so if more than one person in your home is hurting, you can find help in one place, with counselors who know each other's work.
blocks.faith.heading: Faith at the center. Never forced.
blocks.faith.body:
Faith is central to how we work. Our counselors bring together a biblical worldview, Christian theology, and the best clinical practice.

If you'd rather not bring faith into your counseling, that's completely okay. You'll get the same excellent clinical care, and you decide which parts of faith and worldview, if any, you want to talk about. We follow your lead.
blocks.team.heading: Find the counselor who fits
blocks.team.lede: Choose the counselor who sounds right for you, or let us match you. Either way, you can always switch.
blocks.team.note: Every counselor meets in person or online, and every counselor is accepting new clients.
blocks.start.heading: Getting started is simple

start.steps.title: Reach out
start.steps.text: Request an appointment online, or call {phone}. Share as much or as little as you'd like.

start.steps.title: Get matched
start.steps.text: Choose your counselor, or tell us what's going on and we'll suggest the best fit. Most people are seen the same week.

start.steps.title: Begin
start.steps.text: Meet in our Middletown office or online, whichever fits your life.

blocks.cost.heading: What it costs, up front
blocks.cost.note: per 50-minute session, depending on your counselor
blocks.cost.body: Student sessions with Sophie are $50. We don't bill insurance, but we'll give you a superbill, a receipt you can submit to your insurance for possible out-of-network reimbursement. Many plans cover part of the cost.
blocks.vision.heading: Imagine the weight getting lighter
blocks.vision.body:
Picture a marriage where you talk again instead of bracing for the next argument. A teenager who opens the door. Evenings when your mind finally slows down. Grief you can carry without it carrying you.

Counseling doesn't make life easy. It gives you a steady place, and a steady person, to work through what's hard.
blocks.elsewhere.heading: When another kind of care fits better
blocks.elsewhere.body: We'll always tell you honestly if we're not the right fit. We refer to other providers for severe mental illness that needs psychiatric care or medication management, and for children younger than 8. If that's you, call us anyway, and we'll help you find the right next step.
